turns.utterance: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump. Measure near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare it against the maximum permitted sediment depth.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth in the sump cleaning schedule. Sediment exceeding 25 millimetres requires immediate sump pump out and cleaning.
